info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Closes-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Closure Reporting API allows users to retrieve a list of closed support tickets within the system. This API serves as a resource for customer service teams and management to monitor ticket resolutions and analyze trends in support interactions. By querying this endpoint, users can obtain valuable insights into ticket handling efficiency and customer satisfaction. Typical consumers of this API include support staff and analytics teams looking to enhance operational performance.

get.description: This operation allows users to close an existing ticket in the system, marking it as resolved. Ensure you have the correct ticket ID and sufficient permissions before attempting to close a ticket.

requestBody.description: Request body for closing a ticket. This body should include the necessary information to perform the close operation on a specified ticket.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of closed tickets.

ListSupportTicketsClosesRequest.description: The request body for closing a ticket in the operations GET API endpoint. This string represents the necessary details or context needed to process the ticket closure.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_200.title: Close Ticket Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket closing operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number assigned to the operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the ticket closing operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after the closing operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the closing operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information regarding the closing operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_200.description: Response schema representing the result of closing a ticket operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing audit information related to the ticket's closing operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total processing time, in milliseconds, taken by the server to process the request. This value helps in assessing the performance of the API operation.
